kaps_punt: Steenkool as 'n nie-hernieubare hulpbron - Hoe steenkool gevorm word*; Gebruike van steenkool. (* Steenkool word uit organiese plantoorblyfsels gevorm en is dus nie 'n mineraal.)

items.bewering: Miljoene jare gelede het baie plante in groot moerasgebiede gegroei en doodgegaan.
items.bron: Physical Geology (Panchuk / University of Saskatchewan open textbook), 9.3 Organic Sedimentary Rocks; Palaeontology Online, 'Fossil Focus: Coal swamps' - most coal formed from plant matter in swamps.

items.bewering: Die dooie plante het in water met min suurstof geval. Daarom het hulle nie heeltemal vergaan nie.
items.bron: Physical Geology (University of Saskatchewan open textbook), 9.3 Organic Sedimentary Rocks; LiveScience 'How does coal form' - water shields dead plants from oxygen, so decay is incomplete and the material accumulates.

items.bewering: Lae sand en modder het bo-op hulle opgehoop, en ons noem sulke lae sediment.
items.bron: Physical Geology 9.3 (sediment eventually buries the peat); New World Encyclopedia / American Geosciences Institute on sediment as transported particles deposited in layers.

items.bewering: Die gewig van die lae het hard op die plantoorblyfsels gedruk. Diep in die aarde het die druk en die hitte hulle oor miljoene jare in steenkool verander.
items.bron: USGS FAQ 'What are the types of coal?' (plant material -> peat -> lignite -> bituminous -> anthracite with increasing heat and pressure); Physical Geology 9.3 (burial compresses and heats the organic matter).

items.bewering: So het steenkool ontstaan: 'n donker gesteente wat brand.
items.bron: Physical Geology 9.3 'Organic Sedimentary Rocks' (coal treated as an organic sedimentary rock); USGS 'What is coal?' (combustible, formed from plant material).

items.bewering: Die meeste steenkool is swart.
items.bron: USGS FAQ 'What are the types of coal?' - only lignite (brown coal) is brown; subbituminous, bituminous and anthracite are black. The quantifier 'die meeste' is careful and correct; South African coal is predominantly bituminous (Minerals Council SA coal facts).

items.bewering: Onthou: 'n mineraal is 'n natuurlike, nie-lewende vaste stof in die gesteentes van die aardkors
items.blok: Waarom steenkool nie 'n mineraal is nie
items.bron: Maricopa open text 'What is a mineral?' and Nevada Mining 'Is it a mineral?' - naturally occurring, inorganic, solid. As a simplification it is acceptable on its own; see the next item for how it is used.

items.bewering: Steenkool val buite hierdie omskrywing, want dit het uit plante gevorm wat eens gelewe het. Daarom is steenkool nie 'n mineraal nie.
items.blok: Waarom steenkool nie 'n mineraal is nie
items.bron: Maricopa open text 'What is a mineral?'; Macmillan 'Understanding Earth' ch. 3 - coal is excluded because it is ORGANIC (formed from living matter), not because it is living. The conclusion (coal is not a mineral) is correct; the stated reasoning does not follow from the definition the lesson gives.
items.regstelling: The block's own definition says a mineral is 'nie-lewend'. Coal is not living either, so by the words the lesson gives, coal fits the definition and does NOT fall outside it - a learner applying it would conclude coal is a mineral. The criterion that excludes coal is ORIGIN: a mineral does not form from living things; coal formed from plants that once lived. The sentence that draws the conclusion must name that criterion explicitly (for example, that coal is also not alive, but a mineral does not form from the remains of living things, and coal did). If 'nie-lewende' in the mineral definition is an agreed shared wording, do not change the definition here; fix the bridging sentence, and a person should consider whether the shared definition needs the origin criterion too.

items.bewering: Steenkool is eerder 'n fossielbrandstof: 'n brandstof wat oor miljoene jare uit die oorblyfsels van lewende dinge gevorm het.
items.blok: Waarom steenkool nie 'n mineraal is nie
items.bron: US Department of Energy Coal Factsheet (2024); USGS 'What is coal?' - coal is a fossil fuel formed over millions of years from buried plant remains.

items.bewering: Steenkool is 'n nie-hernubare hulpbron, want dit neem miljoene jare om te vorm. Ons gebruik dit baie vinniger op as wat dit vorm.
items.bron: US DOE Coal Factsheet (2024); USGS coal FAQs - coalification takes millions of years; coal is classed as non-renewable.

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika het nog baie steenkool, maar dit sal eendag opraak.
items.bron: South African Journal of Science (2010) review of SA coal reserves (about 31 Gt after DME revision); EIA-based figures of about 30 billion tonnes proved reserves (gem.wiki 'South Africa and coal'); reserves are finite.

items.bewering: Die meeste van Suid-Afrika se elektrisiteit kom uit steenkoolkragstasies.
items.bron: Stats SA 'A breakdown of South Africa's energy mix' (coal drove 83% of electricity generation in 2024); Energize / Ember reporting about 81% in 2025 and monthly lows near 68-74%. Still clearly a majority; 'die meeste' is correct and appropriately unnumbered.

items.bewering: Daar verhit brandende steenkool water totdat dit in stoom verander. Die stoom draai turbines, en dié dryf kragopwekkers aan wat die elektrisiteit maak.
items.bron: Union of Concerned Scientists 'How Coal Works'; University of Kentucky Geological Survey 'Coal for Electricity Generation' - burning coal boils water to steam, steam turns the turbine, the turbine spins the generator.

items.bewering: Brandende steenkool stel ook rook en gasse vry wat die lug vuil maak.
items.bron: Union of Concerned Scientists 'How Coal Works' (sulphur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, particulates from coal combustion).

items.bewering: Steenkool word ook gebruik om yster uit ystererts te maak, en van yster maak ons staal.
items.blok: Yster, petrol en plastiek uit steenkool
items.bron: World Steel Association raw materials fact sheet; World Coal Association coal and steel page - coal is made into coke, which reduces iron ore to iron in the blast furnace; the iron is made into steel. The lesson's 'steenkool' rather than 'kooks' is an acceptable simplification.

items.bewering: By Secunda in Mpumalanga maak Sasol petrol en diesel uit steenkool.
items.blok: Yster, petrol en plastiek uit steenkool
items.bron: Sasol (sasol.com overview); NETL Gasifipedia 'Sasol'; Green Building Africa on Ramaphosa's 2026 Secunda visit - Secunda converts coal into fuels including petrol and diesel.

items.bewering: Uit steenkool kry ons ook stowwe waaruit chemikalieë en plastiek gemaak word.
items.blok: Yster, petrol en plastiek uit steenkool
items.bron: Sasol (sasol.com) - syngas from coal gives chemical feedstock for solvents and polymers; propylene from Secunda goes into polypropylene.

items.bewering: steenkool: 'n Donker gesteente wat brand en uit die oorblyfsels van plante gevorm het. Die meeste steenkool is swart.
items.bron: USGS 'What is coal?' and 'What are the types of coal?'; Physical Geology 9.3.

items.bewering: fossielbrandstof: 'n Brandstof wat oor miljoene jare uit die oorblyfsels van lewende dinge gevorm het.
items.bron: US DOE Coal Factsheet (2024); USGS coal FAQs.

items.bewering: nie-hernubaar: Wat nie vinnig genoeg weer aangevul word nie, sodat dit eendag kan opraak as ons dit aanhou gebruik.
items.bron: US DOE Coal Factsheet (2024) - non-renewable resources are not replenished on a human timescale.

items.bewering: moeras: 'n Nat gebied waar vlak water lank op die grond staan en baie plante groei.
items.bron: Encyclopaedia Britannica (wetland summary) and Lumen Learning 'Wetlands' - saturated, often flooded low-lying land with dense vegetation. 'lank' rather than 'altyd' keeps it correct.

items.bewering: sediment: Sand, modder en ander klein deeltjies wat in lae bo-op mekaar gaan lê.
items.bron: New World Encyclopedia 'Sediment'; American Geosciences Institute - particles transported and deposited, accumulating in layers.

items.bewering: kragstasie: Die plek waar elektrisiteit gemaak word om na baie geboue te stuur.
items.bron: University of Kentucky Geological Survey 'Coal for Electricity Generation' (power plants generate electricity for the grid).

items.bewering: steenkoolkragstasie: 'n Kragstasie wat elektrisiteit maak deur steenkool te verbrand.
items.bron: Union of Concerned Scientists 'How Coal Works'.

items.bewering: turbine: 'n Wiel met lemme wat draai wanneer water, stoom, gas of wind daarteen stoot.
items.bron: Union of Concerned Scientists 'How Coal Works' (steam pushes against turbine blades and spins them); the same principle applies to hydro, gas and wind turbines.

items.bewering: kragopwekker: 'n Masjien wat elektrisiteit maak wanneer 'n deel daarin draai.
items.bron: Union of Concerned Scientists 'How Coal Works' (the turbine spins the generator's rotor, producing electricity).

opsomming: One fault: the block on why coal is not a mineral defines a mineral as 'nie-lewend' and then says coal falls outside that definition because it formed from once-living plants, but coal is not living either, so the reasoning contradicts its own definition; the sentence must name the real criterion (a mineral does not form from living things), and if the mineral wording is shared a person should consider adding that criterion to it. Everything else, including both 'die meeste' quantifiers (most coal is black; most SA electricity is from coal, about 81-83%), checked out; the lesson has no analogies.
